tema: being brave on the first day of school
baslik: Pip the Bunny's First Day at Meadow School
ders: Being brave can be saying hello
aciklama: Pip feels nervous on the first day of school, then makes a new friend by saying hello. A gentle story for children starting school.

satirlar.metin: Momo, today is my first day at Meadow School. My tummy feels wiggly!
Mine felt wiggly too on my first day. That's okay!
At Meadow School, Teacher Luna was waiting with a warm smile.
Hoo! Welcome, Pip! We are going to paint and sing today.
Paint and sing? Maybe school is not so wiggly after all.
Pip saw a little frog sitting all alone by the fence.
Hi, I'm Pip. Do you want to paint with me?
Yes, please! I'm Bloop, and it's my first day too!
Momo, I made a new friend, and we painted a big sun!
Being brave can be small, like saying hello to someone new.
